Subject: MAP launch: technical handoff and SE introductions (Trilo)

Hi Ash —

Thanks again for the productive demo last week. Per our conversation I’m sharing the initial Mutual Action Plan (attached) with suggested milestones and a recommended 6-week evaluation timeline so we can get a POC running quickly. Primary goals we outlined:

- 3K daily inference requests peak, latency target 250ms p95
- Validate relevance/QA across product search flows
- Confirm production routing and deployment model (hosted vs. Dedicated)

I’d like to introduce the folks who will own the technical delivery from Redwood:
- Dylan Brooks (Solutions Engineer) — will lead the technical kickoff and run the integration/POC workstreams
- Monica Patel (Customer Success) — will coordinate acceptance criteria, test cases, and success metrics

Karthik on my team is the AE and will manage commercial cadence. Dylan, can you lead a 60-min technical kickoff this week? Ash/Sofia, please share your engineering lead for the kickoff and any hard blackout dates.

I attached Trilo_MAP_v1.pdf which has the milestone table and a proposed schedule. Also included is a short network requirements spreadsheet.

Proposed next steps:
1) Confirm attendees for the technical kickoff (SE + customer engineering lead)
2) Select one of the times on this scheduling link: https://cal.com/redwood/trilo-map-kickoff
3) Dylan to send a pre-kickoff checklist and request for perf targets / sample dataset access

Thanks — looking forward to getting this moving.

Best,
Evelyn Hart
Account Executive | Redwood Inference

+1 (415) 555-0182

A few clarifications from our side:
- Confirming peak QPS: we expect peak of ~3K requests/day but sustained window is typically 30–60 minutes during peak business hours; average sequence length is ~220 tokens (including prompt).
- Data residency: customer data must stay in us-west region for the POC (we can discuss Private later).
- NDA: we have an internal process; can you share the standard Duke-level NDA or DocuSign link if needed?

Can you also add acceptance criteria to the MAP around latency (250ms p95) and relevance thresholds (example eval set results)?

Hi Ash / Sofia —

Thanks — invite accepted for Wed 11:00 PT. Per the agenda, I’ve attached a short pre-kickoff checklist (see redwood_network_requirements.xlsx) and a list of items that will help us make the first session productive:

Required before kickoff if possible:
- Short sample dataset or sanitized sample prompts (S3 link or shared Drive)
- IAM account or temporary API key for test environment + service IP allowlist
- Network firewall rules (we’ve attached our standard ports and IP ranges)
- A named contact for ops-level questions during POC (email + Slack)

Technical questions for the kickoff:
1) Expected max tokens per request (you mentioned ~220 tokens; is that including metadata? if not, what is prompt+response breakdown)
2) Any encryption-at-rest requirements beyond standard cloud KMS?
3) Will you stream responses or do full-response calls?

I’ll also bring an initial JSON schema for telemetry events so we can align on observability and success metric reporting.

If you prefer, we can also run a short smoke test in the first 30 mins to confirm connectivity.

Cheers,
Dylan Brooks
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
dylan@redwood.com

Dylan / team — thanks for the checklist, this is exactly the level of detail we need. Quick answers inline:

> 1) Expected max tokens per request (you mentioned ~220 tokens; is that including metadata? if not, what is prompt+response breakdown)
- That’s total. Breakdown: prompt ~130 tokens, expected response ~90 tokens.

> 2) Any encryption-at-rest requirements beyond standard cloud KMS?
- No additional requirements for POC — standard cloud KMS is fine.

> 3) Will you stream responses or do full-response calls?
- We’ll start with full-response calls for evaluation; may move to streaming later.

We will upload a sanitized sample dataset to the shared Drive by EOD today and provide a contact for ops (Bryan Lee, bryan.lee@trilo.io). Also confirming us-west hosting is required for the POC.

Two small asks before kickoff:
- Can Redwood add an explicit acceptance criterion in the MAP for response correctness on our eval set (target: >=85% pass on our rubric)?
- Could you send the DocuSign NDA for signature; we’ll route internally as soon as it arrives.

Looking forward to Wednesday.

Ash
